info.title: Veyro API
info.description: Parking, tracking and indoor navigation API

password.description: 10-128 chars, at least one letter and one digit

photoUrl.description: External https image URL; ignored once a photo is uploaded
External https image URL; ignored once a photo is uploaded

permissions.description: Defaults to family access (view, location, record parking, alerts)

levelLabel.description: Free text level (PB, B1, B2…) when no mapped level exists
Free text level (PB, B1, B2…) when no mapped level exists

userId.description: Link to a platform user who is a DRIVER member
Link to a platform user who is a DRIVER member

distanceMeters.description: Defaults to euclidean distance for walk edges

version.description: Version the editor started from (0 if none); stale saves get 409

source.description: Defaults to landmark when nodeId is given, else manual_level

floorEstimate.description: Level code the sensor believes the user is on

confidence.description: Defaults to 1 for manual input (the user states where they are)

roles.description: UI convenience: PLATFORM_ADMIN presence sets role
